text.p: Following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The president and parliamentary foreign affairs commission fear NATO is distancing itself from Estonia.
- Police launched a criminal investigation on Wednesday into allegations that a member of the Rural People's Party was kidnapped by his colleagues.
- A large number of bankers are running for local council seats.
- Fuel firms are split over the Oil Importers Union plan to introduce stricter assets and capital requirements.
- Estonia's leading bank Hansa Bank intends to establish a property insurance firm next year.
- The lottery firm Eesti loto signed a cooperation agreement with Austria's Novo-Invest to establish a casino in Tallin.
